cohort: The study included 13,221 pregnant women from 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan Province, China, with an average age of 20.01 years and an average prepregnancy BMI of 22.26 kg/m2.
finding: Low prepregnancy weight is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including caesarean section, low birth weight, and premature delivery, with prepregnancy BMI directly influencing birth weight and indirectly modulating preterm risk through gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Underweight women were found to have an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to normal weight women.
